definitions.explanation: The word or phrase listed as the main entry in a dictionary, encyclopedia, or index under which definitions and information are given.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{辞書|じしょ}→辞書：04707_jisho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見出|みだ}し{語|ご}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{五万語|ごまんご}⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
{見出|みだ}し{語|ご}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{太字|ふとじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{表示|ひょうじ}→表示：03143_hyouji⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The headwords are displayed in bold.

examples.japanese: ⟦{動詞|どうし}→動詞：03472_doushi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{終止形|しゅうしけい}→終止形：23611_shuushikei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{見出|みだ}し{語|ご}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{載|の}っている→載る：27882_noru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、「⟦{食|た}べます→食べる：00396_taberu⟧」⟦では→では：02945_deha⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧「⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧」⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧。
examples.english: Verbs are listed as headwords in their dictionary form, so you look up 'taberu,' not 'tabemasu.'

notes:
A compound of ⟦{見出|みだ}し→見出し：04440_midashi⟧ (heading/headline) and ⟦{語|ご}→〜語：09841_go⟧ (word). This is an essential term for anyone learning how to use Japanese dictionaries. In Japanese lexicography, verbs are listed in their ⟦{終止形|しゅうしけい}→終止形：23611_shuushikei⟧ (dictionary form), adjectives in their basic form, and nouns as-is.

The term is also used metaphorically in publishing and journalism to refer to the key terms that organize content.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {見出|みだ}し{語|ご}{数|すう}: number of headwords
- {見出|みだ}し{語|ご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: to look up a headword
- {見出|みだ}し{語|ご}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{載|の}る→載る：27882_noru⟧: to be listed as a headword
